<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli.mjs from `skillpouch --help`. Do not edit; run `pnpm --filter @skillpouch/docs gen:cli`. -->

Connect this computer to your SkillPouch account.

Without a token, `skillpouch login` opens an approval page in your browser and prints an 8-digit code in the terminal. Type that code on the page (in a browser where you are signed in and unlocked), then choose **Authorize**. With `--no-browser` it prints the link instead, to open on any device. Ctrl+C cancels; nothing is saved.

With a token (it starts with `sp_lt_`), it connects without a browser on this computer: create one in the web app under Account → Devices → Connect CLI. A token works once and expires after 10 minutes.

In an interactive terminal, a successful login goes straight on to the dashboard to choose a pouch and assistants. Once the computer is set up, the [background sync](/cli/background-sync/) starts.

## Usage

```sh
skillpouch login [OPTIONS] [TOKEN]
```

## Arguments

| Argument  | What it does                                             |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[TOKEN]` | One-time token from "Connect a computer" in the web app. |

## Options

| Option          | What it does                                                     |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--name <NAME>` | Name shown on your Devices page (default: this computer's name). |
| `--no-browser`  | Print the approval link instead of opening a browser.            |
